title: Against All Odds
description: A Los Angeles bookie (James Woods) hires an ex-football star (Jeff Bridges) to find his runaway mistress (Rachel Ward) in Mexico.

title: Maximum Risk
description: Federal agents and the Russian Mafia chase a French policeman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) on a mission in New York City.

title: Felon
description: A new convict (Stephen Dorff) struggles to maintain his sanity and sense of humanity after he's thrust into a prison system in which a brutal guard (Harold Perrineau) encourages gladiatorial combat between inmates.

title: The Devil's Own
description: A New York policeman (Harrison Ford) learns that his Irish houseguest (Brad Pitt) is an IRA terrorist seeking U.S. weapons.

title: Battle: Los Angeles
description: After the world's great cities fall, a Marine staff sergeant (Aaron Eckhart) and his platoon make a last stand against alien invaders.

title: Sahara
description: An Army sergeant (James Belushi), his crew (Mark Lee, Paul Empson) and stragglers try to hold off a Nazi battalion at a Libyan waterhole.

title: The Beast
description: Afghan villagers use a found weapon to hunt a Soviet commander's (George Dzundza) tank trapped in a valley.

title: Little Nikita
description: An FBI agent (Sidney Poitier) finds a dormant link between an Air Force Academy applicant's (River Phoenix) parents and the KGB.

title: Wings of Courage
description: A pilot (Craig Sheffer) crashes during a terrible storm, walks away, and gets lost in the Andes Mountains.

title: Swept Away
description: While boating from Greece to Italy, a wealthy woman (Madonna) and a sailor (Adriano Giannini) become stranded on a desert island.

title: The Deal
description: Laura's family dies in a fire while living in Spain, and as she prepares to move back to the United States, she learns their deaths were not accidental. She goes undercover to find out the truth and becomes embroiled in mob crimes.

title: Cowboy Up
description: While dreaming of becoming a champion bull-rider, a rising star (Marcus Thomas) falls for the woman (Daryl Hannah) his brother (Kiefer Sutherland) loves.

title: Breakout
description: A woman (Jill Ireland) hires a bush pilot (Charles Bronson) to free her husband (Robert Duvall), framed for a murder, from a Mexican prison.

title: Krull
description: A prince (Ken Marshall) needs a razor-tipped boomerang to free his beloved (Lysette Anthony) from the fortress of the Beast.

title: Blue Thunder
description: A Los Angeles police pilot (Roy Scheider) commandeers a helicopter equipped with snooping gadgets and trick weapons.

title: The 6th Day
description: When a man (Arnold Schwarzenegger) discovers he has been illegally cloned, he must outrun assassins trying to protect their secret experiment.

title: The Cave
description: Deadly monsters hunt members (Cole Hauser, Morris Chestnut, Eddie Cibrian) of an exploration team within a vast network of caverns beneath the Carpathian Mountains.

title: Red Water
description: A shark terrorizes a divorced couple (Lou Diamond Phillips, Kristy Swanson) and three boat hijackers on a Louisiana river.

title: Sahara
description: An Army sergeant (James Belushi), his crew (Mark Lee, Paul Empson) and stragglers try to hold off a Nazi battalion at a Libyan waterhole.

title: Crossroads
description: A guitar student (Ralph Macchio) tours the Deep South with an old blues man (Joe Seneca), chasing a lost song written by Robert Johnson.

title: Jury Duty
description: A goof-off juror (Pauly Shore) stalls a trial to take advantage of his lifestyle being paid for by the court.

title: Cops and Robbersons
description: Police partners move in with a would-be policeman (Chevy Chase) and his family to monitor a criminal next door.

title: Side Out
description: A former basketball star (C. Thomas Howell) and a down-and-outer (Peter Horton) enter a California beach volleyball tournament.

title: The Throwaways
description: Given a choice to work for the CIA or go to prison, a notorious hacker (Sam Huntington) accepts the job but turns the tables on his employers by assembling a team comprised of poorly regarded individuals.

title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
description: An FBI agent (Colin Hanks) must spy on his mother (Meg Ryan) after she becomes involved with a suspected art thief (Antonio Banderas).

title: Bermuda Triangle
description: A physician's (Sam Behrens) family is stranded on an island community of survivors presumed lost in the infamous Bermuda Triangle.

title: Wild America
description: Three Arkansas brothers (Jonathan Taylor Thomas, Devon Sawa, Scott Bairstow) travel across the country filming animals in their habitats during the summer of 1967.

title: Big Fish
description: A young journalist (Billy Crudup) searches for the truth behind the tall tales told by his ailing father (Albert Finney).

title: Devil in a Blue Dress
description: A mortgage and no job force a black war hero (Denzel Washington) to seek a mystery lady (Jennifer Beals) for a shady guy (Tom Sizemore) in 1948 Los Angeles.

title: Company of Heroes
description: During World War II, a group of American soldiers heads to the heart of Nazi Germany to find a scientist who developed a devastating weapon for Hitler and now wants to defect.

title: Felon
description: A new convict (Stephen Dorff) struggles to maintain his sanity and sense of humanity after he's thrust into a prison system in which a brutal guard (Harold Perrineau) encourages gladiatorial combat between inmates.

title: Maximum Risk
description: Federal agents and the Russian Mafia chase a French policeman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) on a mission in New York City.

title: Air
description: When breathable air becomes nonexistent, two engineers (Norman Reedus, Djimon Hounsou) must guard the remaining survivors who reside in a controlled state of suspended animation.

title: Talhotblond
description: Thomas meets a beautiful teenager online, with whom he engages in a nearly two-year romance over the Internet until she learns the truth about him, which leads Thomas to exact the ultimate revenge.

title: Fugitive Nights: Danger in the Desert
description: A Palm Springs private eye (Teri Garr) wants two policemen (Sam Elliott, Thomas Haden Church) to help her catch a fugitive.

title: First Daughter
description: A female Secret Service agent (Mariel Hemingway) and a river guide (Doug Savant) must rescue the president's kidnapped daughter (Monica Keena).

title: First Target
description: A Secret Service agent trains long and hard to protect the president, only to realize too late that the opening of new mountain transport in Seattle is just a ploy to ambush him.

title: First Shot
description: A military rebel group resurfaces with a vengeance to assassinate the president for the death of their brothers. Agent McGregor, the head of the Secret Service, tries to prevent attacks on the president's life.

title: The Lazarus Project
description: A death-row inmate (Paul Walker) searches for the truth after he mysteriously awakes in a psychiatric hospital.

title: The Cave
description: Deadly monsters hunt members (Cole Hauser, Morris Chestnut, Eddie Cibrian) of an exploration team within a vast network of caverns beneath the Carpathian Mountains.

title: Flatliners
description: Five medical students trigger near-death experiences to gain insight into the mystery of what lies beyond the confines of life. As their experiments become more perilous, each must face the paranormal consequences of journeying to the other side.

title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
description: A scientific expedition sets out for Borneo to seek a flower called the Blood Orchid, which could grant longer life. Meanwhile, they run afoul of snakes and each other.
